premises.text: Digital media creation for games and film is still mostly manual, so art costs too much and takes too long
premises.evidence_span: it's still an almost entirely manual process. Our goal is to half the time and half the cost of this process through automation

premises.text: Example-based AI (Artomatics) generates varied artistic content from artist-provided examples while keeping the artist in control
premises.evidence_span: Artematics is an example-based way of making art. That means you give the computer an example of something you want, and it makes more

premises.text: The system works across artistic data types including images and 3D models, inventing new variations rather than only remixing
premises.evidence_span: It can work on any kind of artistic data

premises.text: Video games are the beachhead market before expanding via Artomatix Cloud to the broader industry
premises.evidence_span: we've identified that video games are our beachhead
We're going to monetize through a software-as-a-service business model

premises.text: IP is controlled and protected via patents and trade secrets
premises.evidence_span: we control all of the IP, and we're protecting it through a combination of patents and trade secrets

value.text: Halve time and cost of digital art creation while enabling richer, more varied game worlds
value.evidence_span: we solve the problem that art costs too much and it takes too long

secondary_value.text: Vitamin upside: worlds with far more variety of characters and content
secondary_value.evidence_span: Imagine a world hundreds of times larger than you've ever seen before

causal_links.evidence_span: half the time and half the cost of this process through automation
video games are our beachhead, and we've already achieved significant traction in this space

notes: Team bios and acquisition offer excluded. Controllability/artist-in-the-loop folded into P2. IP kept inside technology domain as protection of the core mechanism (v1.3.1 #1).
